about: Every recording the tests read. The files live in $SDRKIT_RECORDINGS (default ../sdrkit-recordings beside the workspace), never in git; the repository keeps their .sigmf-meta, expected results and this list. `sdrkit vectors list` shows what is present, `sdrkit vectors verify` checks sizes and checksums, `sdrkit vectors generate` makes the regenerable ones again.
